availability_note: Ramosetron is NOT FDA-approved for use in the United States. It is primarily available in Japan, South Korea, and other Asian markets under brand names like Nasea.

variants.note: Available in Japan as injection and oral formulations

us_availability: NOT approved by FDA for US pharmaceutical market
regulatory_status: Ramosetron has not been approved by the FDA and is not legally available as a pharmaceutical product in the United States. It may only be obtained through international sources or clinical trials.
